label: Abortion attitude score (0 to 7)
notes: Undocumented composite of unknown authorship; its 172 fractional values suggest a 0-7 item count prorated over the items answered. Higher scores go with more liberal views in these data.

label: Cohabitation attitude score (2 to 10)
notes: Undocumented composite of unknown authorship. Higher scores go with more liberal, less religious and younger respondents, so higher probably means more accepting of cohabitation.

label: Respondent's own income bracket
notes: GSS RINCOM98: the respondent's own income (not household income), in unequal brackets. Per the 1998 NORC GSS archive, 798 of the 983 NAs were inapplicable (mainly people without earnings); the source file collapsed all missing reasons to plain NA.

label: Political views
values: 1 = extremely liberal; 2 = liberal; 3 = slightly liberal; 4 = moderate; 5 = slightly conservative; 6 = conservative; 7 = extremely conservative

label: Years of schooling
notes: GSS EDUC, highest year of school completed; 20 = 8 or more years of college.

label: Mother's years of schooling
notes: GSS MAEDUC; 20 = 8 or more years of college.

label: Father's years of schooling
notes: GSS PAEDUC; 20 = 8 or more years of college.

label: Marital status
values: 1 = married; 2 = widowed; 3 = divorced; 4 = separated; 5 = never married

label: Sex partners in the past 5 years
values: 0 = no partners; 1 = 1 partner; 2 = 2 partners; 3 = 3 partners; 4 = 4 partners; 5 = 5 to 10 partners; 6 = 11 to 20 partners; 7 = 21 to 100 partners; 8 = more than 100 partners
notes: GSS PARTNRS5; codes 5 to 8 are ranges (v0.2.0 wrongly said 8 = 8 or more), so treat it as ordinal, not a count. Per the 1998 NORC GSS archive, the 495 NAs include 34 respondents who answered 1 or more without a number (GSS code 9); the source file collapsed all missing reasons to plain NA.

label: Age
notes: GSS AGE; 89 = 89 or older. The 4 respondents with no answer were given the mean age (45.55693), the only non-whole values.

label: Other race
notes: Dummy for race = 3 (neither White nor Black).

label: Religiosity score
notes: Undocumented composite of unknown authorship, with mean 0 and no NAs. Higher scores go with having a religious affiliation and with conservative views in these data.

label: Religious preference
notes: Recode of GSS RELIG: Protestant includes Christian, inter-/nondenominational and Orthodox Christian; other includes Buddhism, Hinduism, other Eastern, Muslim and Native American.
